commands.cmd:
W=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
trap 'rm -rf "$W"' EXIT
L="$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/lean"
HEAD=$(git -C "$L/Lean" --no-optional-locks rev-parse HEAD) || { echo "LEAN_BACKTEST_FAIL: no LEAN source tree"; exit 1; }
[ "$HEAD" = "985ef30ad3ac774218c5ac516b4cb0aa2655730f" ] || { echo "LEAN_BACKTEST_FAIL: source HEAD $HEAD is not the winner pin"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p "$W/run/tmp" || exit 1
cp -a "$L/Lean/Launcher/bin/Debug" "$W/run/launcher" || { echo "LEAN_BACKTEST_FAIL: launcher copy failed"; exit 1; }
cd "$W/run/launcher" || exit 1
rm -f BasicTemplateFrameworkAlgorithm-*.json BasicTemplateFrameworkAlgorithm-log.txt BasicTemplateFrameworkAlgorithm.json data-monitor-report-*.json succeeded-data-requests-*.txt failed-data-requests-*.txt log.txt || exit 1
rm -rf BasicTemplateFrameworkAlgorithm || exit 1
timeout 40 bwrap --unshare-net --die-with-parent --clearenv --setenv HOME "$W/run" --setenv TMPDIR "$W/run/tmp" --setenv PATH /usr/bin:/bin --setenv DOTNET_ROOT "$L/dotnet-10.0.401" --setenv DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT 1 --setenv DOTNET_NOLOGO 1 --ro-bind / / --dev /dev --proc /proc --bind "$W" "$W" --chdir "$W/run/launcher" "$L/dotnet-10.0.401/dotnet" QuantConnect.Lean.Launcher.dll --data-folder "$L/Lean/Data/" --close-automatically true < /dev/null > "$W/run/stdout.txt" 2> "$W/run/stderr.txt"
rc=$?
python3 - "$L/Lean/Algorithm.CSharp/BasicTemplateFrameworkAlgorithm.cs" "$W/run/stdout.txt" "$W/run/stderr.txt" "$W/run/launcher/BasicTemplateFrameworkAlgorithm-order-events.json" "$rc" "$HEAD" <<'PY'
import collections, json, os, re, sys
src_path, out_path, err_path, events_path, rc, head = sys.argv[1:7]
rc = int(rc)
src = open(src_path).read()
block = src[src.index('ExpectedStatistics'):]
block = block[:block.index('};')]
want = dict(re.findall(r'\{"([^"]+)",\s*"([^"]*)"\}', block))
out = open(out_path).read() if os.path.isfile(out_path) else ''
stderr_bytes = os.path.getsize(err_path) if os.path.isfile(err_path) else -1
got = {}
for line in out.splitlines():
    if line.startswith('STATISTICS:: '):
        body = line[13:]
        keys = [k for k in want if body.startswith(k + ' ')]
        if keys:
            key = max(keys, key=len)
            got[key] = body[len(key) + 1:]
bad = {k: (want[k], got.get(k)) for k in want if got.get(k) != want[k]}
points = re.findall(r'Processing total of [0-9,]+ data points', out)
events = json.load(open(events_path)) if os.path.isfile(events_path) else []
counts = dict(collections.Counter(e['status'] for e in events))
ok = rc == 0 and stderr_bytes == 0 and bool(points) and bool(want) and not bad and len(events) == 6 and counts == {'submitted': 3, 'filled': 3}
print('LEAN_BACKTEST_' + ('OK' if ok else 'FAIL'), '| launcher exit', rc, '| stderr bytes', stderr_bytes, '| upstream ExpectedStatistics matched', len(want) - len(bad), 'of', len(want), '| Total Orders', got.get('Total Orders'), '| End Equity', got.get('End Equity'), '| OrderListHash', got.get('OrderListHash'), '| order events', len(events), counts)
print('engine source commit', head, '| data:', points[0] if points else 'no data-point line', '| mismatches', bad)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY

crc=$?
python3 - "$W/control/stdout.txt" "$W/control/stderr.txt" "$crc" <<'PY'
import os, re, sys
out_path, err_path, crc = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], int(sys.argv[3])
has_log = os.path.isfile(out_path) and os.path.getsize(out_path) > 0
out = open(out_path).read() if has_log else ''
err = open(err_path).read() if os.path.isfile(err_path) else ''
hashes = re.findall(r'STATISTICS:: OrderListHash ([0-9a-f]{32})', out)
empty_md5 = 'd41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e'
reason = 'Unable to locate symbol properties file' in err
ok = has_log and crc == 1 and hashes == [empty_md5] and 'STATISTICS:: Total Orders' not in out and reason
print('LEAN_EMPTY_DATA_CONTROL_' + ('OK' if ok else 'FAIL'), '| launcher exit', crc, '(expected 1) | control stdout log bytes', os.path.getsize(out_path) if has_log else 0, '| OrderListHash', hashes, '(md5 of an empty order list is', empty_md5 + ') | Total Orders line present:', 'STATISTICS:: Total Orders' in out, '| stderr names the missing symbol properties database:', reason)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY
